migration.migration_reason: Preserved paid Language Quality findings were independently re-adjudicated against the current fixed five-component design rubric. Legacy normalized scores were retained only for audit and were not used to derive component levels. The snapshot is bound to exact source evidence and the current validator recomputes scores.

recertifier.provider_model_provenance_claim: No Anthropic/Sonnet call is claimed for these reconstructed judgments.

component_findings.abstraction_ceremony: Recertified level 3 under the current criterion: Reusable abstractions such as types, interfaces/traits/generics or equivalent mechanisms can be declared and consumed without excessive scaffolding. Evidence basis: Inspected reusable Rust micro-benchmark programs (mb00-mb11) and adversarial programs under template/programs/rust. Assessed token/line density needed to express the same algorithm relative to idiomatic Rust practice: iterator chains (zip, map), no manual bounds-checked indexing loops except where the frozen algorithm requires index-based updates, preallocated Vec<f64>, no unnecessary cloning. | mb04.rs: core workload uses iterator zip over two f64 vectors with four scalar accumulators, concise and idiomatic; avoids manual index loops in the hot inner loop. | Outer loop anti-elimination update (a_vec[r % M] += 1e-9) requires index-based access intrinsic to the algorithm across all languages, not Rust-specific overhead. | No unnecessary heap allocations inside hot loops; vectors preallocated via vec![0.0f64; M]. | Ownership/borrowing model enables safe zip-based iteration without bounds-check boilerplate or copies (#![forbid(unsafe_code)]). | Struct-based Lcg generator is compact standard encapsulation; no boilerplate beyond Rust's module/impl requirements.

metric.code_efficiency_conciseness.limitations: Comparison-language reprojection requires the preserved paid source evidence plus the historical program/workload/toolchain inputs to match the current shard; mismatches remain misses.
metric.code_efficiency_conciseness.selection_rule: Judge intrinsic mandatory ceremony for the same kinds of ordinary programs. Do not reuse raw LOC/bytes/tokens as the score and do not reward external libraries.

component_findings.consistency_regular_forms: Recertified level 3 under the current criterion: Similar concepts use regular forms with few special-case spellings or context-dependent surface rules. Evidence basis: Reviewed identifier naming, control flow, and structuring conventions in the reusable Rust programs (micro and adversarial sets) for idiomatic readability: function separation, comments citing methodology sections, meaningful variable names, consistent formatting. | Comments cite exact methodology sections and describe algorithmic intent, aiding traceability. | Explicit local type annotations (f64, usize, i64) improve self-documentation without excessive verbosity. | Explicit .expect()/.unwrap_or() error handling avoids hidden control flow, aiding clarity of paths. | Tuple destructuring (let (s1,s2,s3,s4) = ...) names results clearly, improving clarity over positional/pointer outputs. | Adversarial programs are short, single-purpose files isolating one language-edge-case each, aiding per-file readability.
